name: Privacy Policy Generator – Madquick
author: Madquick Digital Agency Private Limited

sections.description:
Privacy Policy Generator – Madquick is a comprehensive plugin that helps website owners quickly generate legal compliance pages and manage user consent.

Key Features

  • Privacy Policy Generator – Create customized privacy policies with a simple form
  • Terms & Conditions – Generate terms and conditions pages (coming soon)
  • GDPR & CCPA Compliance – Built-in templates to help meet privacy law requirements
  • Cookie Consent Banner – Display customizable cookie consent notices
  • Browser Update Banner – Notify users with outdated browsers to upgrade
  • Strong Password Checker – Enforce strong password requirements for better security
  • External Links SEO Control – Automatically add nofollow and noreferrer attributes to external links
  • Mobile Responsive – All generated pages and banners work perfectly on mobile devices
  • Easy Customization – Edit generated pages directly in WordPress editor

Why Use This Plugin?

Staying compliant with privacy regulations like GDPR and CCPA is critical for any website. This plugin simplifies the process by:

  • Generating legally-sound templates
  • Providing customizable forms to match your specific needs
  • Managing user consent through cookie banners
  • Enhancing security with password strength requirements

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Navigate to Privacy & Policy Generator in your WordPress admin
  3. Fill out the form with your website information
  4. Click “Generate” to create your privacy policy page
  5. Customize the generated page if needed
  6. Configure settings for cookie banner and password checker

Privacy & Data

This plugin does NOT collect, store, or transmit any user data to external servers. All data remains on your WordPress installation.

Support

For support, feature requests, or bug reports, please contact:

  • Email: tech@madquick.in
  • GitHub: https://github.com/Madquick-Private-Limited/madquick-ppg

You can find more details in the LICENSE.txt file included with this plugin.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Privacy Policy Generator – Madquick”
  4. Click Install Now
  5. Activate the plugin

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the downloaded ZIP file and click Install Now
  5. Activate the plugin
  6. Access the plugin via Privacy & Policy Generator in your admin menu
sections.faq:
Can I customize the generated privacy policy?

Yes! After generating your privacy policy, you can edit it directly in the WordPress page editor just like any other page.

Does this plugin ensure GDPR compliance?

The plugin provides templates and tools that aid in GDPR and CCPA compliance. However, you should review all generated content with a legal professional to ensure it meets your specific legal requirements.

Can I disable the cookie banner?

Yes. Navigate to Privacy & Policy Generator > Settings and uncheck “Enable Cookie Banner” to disable it.

Does the strong password checker work on login and registration?

Yes. When enabled, the password checker validates password strength on both user login and registration forms.

Can I generate multiple legal pages?

Currently, the plugin focuses on Privacy Policy generation. Terms & Conditions and other legal page templates are planned for future updates.

Will this slow down my website?

No. The plugin is lightweight and only loads necessary assets on relevant pages.

What does the External Links NoFollow feature do?

When enabled in settings, this feature automatically adds rel=”nofollow noreferrer” attributes to all external links on your website. This gives you better SEO control by preventing search engines from following external links and improves privacy by not sending referrer information to external sites.
